_provenance: Schema-derived from project architecture constants and production-typical symphony count. realistic_symphony_count is a realistic upper-bound derived from the AlphaBot operational context (a single Alpaca account may carry 5-15 symphonies). cycle_budget_ms is a conservative fraction of the 60-second cycle budget that remains after core engine work. p99_latency_ms_target is derived as cycle_budget_ms / realistic_symphony_count.

_notes.cycle_budget_ms: 60_000 ms total cycle. The engine's core MC + decision logic is benchmarked at ~200ms at typical portfolio size. We allocate 5% of the remaining budget (59_800ms) to telemetry writes = ~2990ms total for telemetry. Divided by 20 symphonies gives ~150ms per symphony. Using 50ms as the conservative p99 target per symphony adds CI noise headroom.
_notes.realistic_symphony_count: 20 symphonies is the design ceiling for a single-account AlphaBot deployment; this is the worst-case denominator for the per-symphony latency target.
_notes.p99_target_rationale: 50ms per-symphony p99 is 3.3x less than the 150ms per-symphony budget allocation, providing CI noise headroom. A disk SQLite INSERT with WAL mode typically completes in 1-5ms; the 50ms target gives 10-50x margin for CI overhead.
